summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, reporting executive changes effective immediately. Johnny Tiong Sie Wei, a current director, was appointed CEO with a two-year contract, base salary of RMB420,000 annually, and standard benefits. Guangfeng Dai stepped down as COO and President but remains Chairman. Xinyang Li transitioned from CEO to President and COO. These are internal role changes without forced or abrupt departures. Other executives retain their employment terms. No external event or strategic shift is indicated. Watch for potential operational impacts from the leadership reshuffle, but no risk-arb angle exists as this is a routine management adjustment for a foreign private issuer.
